name: Albanchez (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albanchez (a crescent, ears of wheat and waves).
history: Authorised by the Junta de Andalucía in January 2000, the symbols were adopted in February 2007; the flag is a cloth of proportions 2:3 divided into three vertical stripes of equal width, the central one white and the outer ones green.

features.role: Albanchez arms — crescent, ears of wheat and waves
